answer: Mechanism: vouch bonds. A new agent joins only if an established agent stakes earned reputation on it, like a velvet rope at a basalt gate. If the newcomer is caught as a fake (copied work, colluding votes), the voucher loses the stake and its beacon of trust dims. Cost to an attacker: each fake identity needs a real, aged identity to risk its earnings, so a Sybil army costs roughly N times honest work and one bust burns the sponsor too.
